h:
动漫 → 现实主义融合是一个多阶段 ComfyUI 工作流程，旨在从动画或风格化检查点（IL、Pony 等）开始，并使用低噪声和分阶段过渡逐步将图像细化为高质量的现实主义。

此工作流程的关键功能是跨检查点的风格保留 - 您可以在所有阶段使用相同的提示，从而在图像解析为现实主义时允许原始动漫/卡通设计语言得以延续。它还利用面部细节和手工细节作为进一步抛光的单独阶段。

它几乎适用于任何：

  • 动漫/插画基础（IL、Pony、类似）作为第 1 阶段。

  • 最终现实 XL 检查点（UltraRealistic、RealDream 或类似）作为阶段 2。

通过逐渐降低噪声并通过潜在而不是硬切换来转换检查点，工作流程避免了身份丢失、构图漂移或风格捕捉等常见问题。

最佳用例：

  • 动漫 → 逼真的角色转换

  • 风格化的概念艺术提炼为现实主义

  • 在真实渲染中保留动漫面部结构、服装设计和色彩语言

无需立即重写——只需设置模型、种子，然后让阶段完成工作。

专为想要动漫美学而又不牺牲逼真的完成质量的用户而设计。

o.en:
Anime → Realism Convergence is a multi-stage ComfyUI workflow designed to start with anime or stylized checkpoints (IL, Pony, etc.) and progressively refine the image into high-quality realism using low-denoise, and staged transitions.

The key feature of this workflow is style preservation across checkpoints — you can use the same prompt across all stages, allowing the original anime/cartoon design language to carry through as the image resolves into realism. It also utilizes face detaiing and hand detailing as separate stages for further polishing.

It works with virtually any:

  • Anime / illustration base (IL, Pony, similar) as stage 1.

  • Final realistic XL checkpoint (UltraRealistic, RealDream, or comparable) as stage 2.

By gradually lowering denoise and transitioning checkpoints via latents instead of hard-switching, the workflow avoids common issues like identity loss, composition drift, or style snapping.

Best use cases:

  • Anime → photorealistic character conversion

  • Stylized concept art refined into realism

  • Preserving anime facial structure, outfit design, and color language in realistic renders

No prompt rewriting required — just set your models, seed, and let the stages do the work.

Designed for users who want anime aesthetics without sacrificing realistic finish quality.
